lines.trans: Hello Isabelle, how are you feeling?

words.gram: inverted 2sg present: te sens-tu = do you feel

lines.trans: I was in the middle of rehearsing Hamlet.

words.gloss: train; en train de = in the process of

lines.trans: You are playing Hamlet next March?
Yes, with the magnificent Scarlett Johansson.
Are you not too exhausted?
I am wiped out but so happy.
How do you cope with two shoots?
Exhaustion plunges me into a trance.
It is an almost euphoric state!
It is an absolutely divine artistic feeling.
Do you take medicine to keep going?
My only drug is dried fruit!
Put on your hat quickly for Delphine.
I am going, the set is waiting for me!
Hello Isabelle, how are you feeling?

examples.text: Ça va? Oui, ça va bien.
examples.trans: How are you? Yes, I'm fine.

meanings.note: ça va? = how are you? / are you okay?
as an interjection: bon, alors... = right, so...

meanings.en: bonne journée = have a nice day

meanings.note: the standard greeting during the day
before a noun: ce film, cette tête, ces gens
as a pronoun in c'est, ce n'est pas; becomes c' before a vowel
comment ça va? = how are you?
dans une heure = in an hour

examples.text: La plus grande imprésario de Paris.
Ma seule drogue, c'est les fruits secs.
examples.trans: My only drug is dried fruit.

meanings.note: preposition: en vacances, en huit ans
pronoun before the verb: j'en ai assez, je n'en peux plus

examples.trans: It is an almost euphoric state.
I'm eating a piece of fruit.

examples.text: Je suis très heureux pour vous.
Il joue le frère de Guillaume.

meanings.note: jouer un rôle, jouer le frère de...
jouer au foot, jouer du piano
before the verb: vous la connaissez? les voilà

examples.text: Je veux, mais je ne peux pas.
examples.trans: I want to, but I can't.

examples.text: Elle joue au théâtre en mars.
examples.trans: She performs at the theater in March.

meanings.note: object pronoun before the verb: tu me donnes
with reflexive verbs: je me débrouille

examples.text: Tu as mis ta photo dans cette enveloppe?
examples.trans: Did you put your photo in this envelope?

examples.text: Je prends un médicament pour le dos.
examples.trans: I'm taking medicine for my back.

meanings.note: prendre un médicament = to take medicine
ne ... pas: not; ne ... plus: not anymore; ne ... jamais: never

meanings.en: pas du tout: not at all

examples.text: Tu dois retourner sur le plateau.
examples.trans: You must go back to the set.

examples.text: Tout le monde est sur le plateau.
La fatigue me plonge dans une transe.
examples.trans: Fatigue plunges me into a trance.

examples.text: Je suis là pour voir Mathias.
C'est le prochain film de Tarantino.

meanings.note: before the noun: le prochain film

meanings.en: to rehearse, to practise (a role, a play)

meanings.note: une scène d'amour = a love scene
se sentir + adjective = to feel (a certain way): je me sens nulle
je sens quelque chose de compliqué
before the noun: le seul agent
before the verb; t' before a vowel
c'est tellement stupide = it's so stupid
informal, one owner; ton, ta, tes

examples.text: Le tournage commence dans trois semaines.

meanings.note: from tourner un film = to shoot a film
prendre le train = to take the train
être en train de faire = to be in the middle of doing

examples.text: Il est en train de travailler.
examples.trans: He is in the middle of working.

examples.text: Elle est trop vieille pour le rôle.
examples.trans: She's too old for the part.

meanings.note: singular and informal: friends, family, children, colleagues of the same age
il y a = there is / there are
j'y pense = I think about it
en bon état = in good condition

meanings.en: être dans tous ses états = to be worked up / beside oneself

meanings.note: masculine; often capitalized when meaning country/State

examples.text: Tu es dans tous tes états.
La voiture est en parfait état.
examples.trans: The car is in perfect condition.
